title: Last year to deduct PS savings
message: {figure3} is the last year for eligible PS contributions to qualify for a tax deduction, generally within a combined {max} € annual cap and other conditions. The balance itself is not deductible. Check eligibility before paying in more.
earns: Nordea earns nothing from this information.
_note: Student concept. Figures read on the official source on the checkedAt date; not tax or legal advice.
explain: Eligible PS contributions paid in {figure4} can still qualify for a deduction, generally within a combined annual {figure5} € cap with voluntary individual pension insurance and other eligibility limits. The balance is not deductible. Contributions from {figure6} January {figure7} are not deductible. If total PS savings were no more than {figure8} € ON {figure9} January {figure10} the whole balance may qualify for withdrawal in {figure11} or {figure12} without punitive tax uplift, provided scheduled retirement withdrawals have not begun. Withdrawal remains taxable under normal rules, not tax-free; final tax depends on total capital income. Do not assume earlier contributions were deducted.
